note-WorkflowCreator.text: Workflows tab. Try: tick or untick scripts, switch the runner, switch Private ↔ Encrypted public builder — the YAML preview on the right changes. Tweaks: accent, motion. Stands for the real Workflows tab (shipped). Unbuilt: drag-to-reorder (the app uses ↑/↓), stage boards for loading/empty/error.

note-RepoWorkflows.text: The repository's own workflows, chosen per file or with Run all. Chips show what gets rewritten (manual start, read-only token, removed publishing, sealed artifacts, missing secrets). Try: Run all / None and the checkboxes. Tweaks: accent, motion. Real behaviour shipped on branch feat/source-workflows-cli; not yet run against real GitHub.

note-Runs.text: Runs tab with a resumed encrypted build (flowing segment = the active stage) and a finished one listing decrypted build outputs. Tweaks: accent, motion (stills the orbs, entrance, flow). Stands for the real Runs tab. Unbuilt: per-run sub-run chips board, empty and offline stages.

note-EncryptedRun.text: Detail view for one encrypted public run: 9 stages, temporary key countdown, what the public can see. Tweaks: accent, motion. The app shows this as a run card, not a separate page yet — this board is ahead of the build.

note-Recovery.text: What the app shows after it was closed mid-run: the run journal picked builds back up. Tweaks: accent, motion. Real banner shipped; this richer per-run summary is design only.

note-Main.text: Original v1 screen: Dockerfile in, Docker image out. Try the platform buttons. Tweaks: accent, motion. The app now shows this under the Dockerfile tab with the run modes beside it.

note-SignIn.text: Assisted GitHub CLI login in the app: device code, scopes, waiting dots. Tweaks: accent, motion. Shipped in the GUI; the CLI twin is on the mac CLI page.

note-Cli.text: mac CLI: assisted login with the device code, then an encrypted build of every script and workflow. Tweaks: accent, motion (stills the cursor and spinner). Shipped on branch feat/source-workflows-cli.

note-Docs.text: Docs site hero and how-it-works. Tweaks: accent, motion. Live Docs site waits on GitHub Pages being turned on. Unbuilt: CLI and repository-workflow sections on this board (they exist in the real docs/).

title-setup.text: Setup wizard, tour and personal wording

note-Shell.text: Tab strip with every page open, an active underline that springs between tabs, the Ctrl+Shift+F palette with live setting controls, and the context menu with its shortcuts. Try: click tabs; the search button toggles the palette. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage (palette/tabs). Stands for public/js/ui/tabs.js, palette.js and menu.js. Not shown: drag-reorder animation, catalog menu, pinned tabs. These boards were added after the code in this pass.

note-Onboarding.text: Five-step setup wizard (language, GitHub check, default run mode, personal wording, ready) with Back, Next and Skip, then the Take a tour coach card with a pulsing ring on the real tab. Try: Back/Next. Tweaks: accent, motion, step. Stands for public/js/ui/onboarding.js. Not verified: screen-reader pass; tour steps on narrow screens.

note-Vocab.text: Personal wording: the JSON, the same failed build before and after, the window-wide drop zone and the celebration burst. Try: idle/dragging/applied. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage. Stands for vocab.js, settings.js loadVocabFile and the drop handler in app.js. Checked in headless Chrome: failure text and server text are rewritten and nothing reaches settings history.

note-Records.text: Completeness page (125 features: 36 done, 28 partial, 49 not built, 12 not applicable, with filters) beside the History tab (notifications plus settings changes with Restore). Try: the status filter. Tweaks: accent, motion, filter. Stands for views/info.js, public/completeness.json and test/completeness.test.js. Rows are a sample.

note-Extensions.text: Searchable extension manager: built-in defaults, permission chips and switches, the last run's JSON-line exchange, and the consent dialog shown when a new version asks for a new permission. Try: the switches; Allow / Keep it off. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage (consent/list/timeout). Drawn before the code. Built since: public/js/views/extensions.js and src/extensions.js; the app shows the last result per card instead of the raw exchange. Not planned: an operating-system sandbox.

note-Linux.text: The Linux run path: scripts/run-linux.sh checks Node, the GitHub CLI, folders and the port, starts the server, and can install a systemd user service. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage (ready/missing-gh). Drawn before the code. Built since and run on Linux. Not verified: starting the service under a real systemd user session.

note-Workspace.text: Dockable workspace: runs on the left, the selected run's step log and a where-the-time-went chart in the middle, outputs and extension results on the right. Try: pick a run. Tweaks: accent, motion, layout (three/two). Drawn before the code. Built since: public/js/views/workspace.js on dockview. The real panels drag, split and float; this still board only describes that.

note-Gallery.text: Extension gallery: add a bundled sample or drop a .zip; a card that says plainly whether extensions are sandboxed on this computer; and running an extension on a finished run. Try: Add. Tweaks: accent, motion, isolation (sandboxed/none). Drawn before the code. Built since; in the app the run action lives in the Workspace's Extension results panel.

note-Recipes.text: Recipes: a saved Workflows form with a name, mode, chips for what runs, a schedule and the last result; Run now starts it. Try: Run now. Tweaks: accent, motion, stage (recipes/empty). Drawn before the code. Built since: src/recipes.js and public/js/views/recipes.js. Schedules need the app running.

note-Tools.text: The Tools tab: Base64, converter and JSON studio as input to output, with the notes the app shows (lossy flattening; built-in generator, not quicktype). Try: the three tabs. Tweaks: accent, motion, tool. This board was drawn after the code shipped. The real screens have more controls (files, images, tree editor).
